name: Selective regression, staged verification and hermetic success reuse

sources.title: Paul Hammant, The Rise of Test Impact Analysis

hypothesis: Reviewed dependency scope and complete input fingerprints reduce repeated local executions without weakening integration or fresh release requirements.
limits: A declarative graph/hermetic flag cannot prove hidden dependencies absent. Tool defaults evolve; no native build platform or commercial productivity guarantee is adopted.
experiment: Temporary Git repositories with real processes, selection/invalidation/tamper/failure controls, response replay and independent review; preserve 5.0.0 baseline.
rollback: Restore coherent 5.0.0 package; never silently use new cached results under old runner semantics.
